article_summaries.title: Free Realms - Quais são as Novidades?
article_summaries.summary: This Wayback copy is a Portuguese-language news page whose only substantive text is a Spanish-language notice about a weekend sale of Free Realms Trading Card Game (TCG) sets 1-3 booster packs. The page gives a relative publish date ('2 months, 2 days ago') with no absolute date; the sale window (Friday 31 August to Tuesday 4 September) matches 2012. The rest of the text is site navigation and legal boilerplate.
